GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2025-02-18T17:09:07Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Order Guarantees with the Async API
Description: Hey,
I’m wondering if the following example guarantees execution order:
```
RBucket<String> bucket = redisson.getBucket("key");

bucket.setAsync("value"); // Fire SET without waiting
RFuture<String> future = bucket.getAsync(); 

future.thenAccept(System.out::println); 
```
Does SET always execute before GET, even though SET wasn’t explicitly awaited?
